name: test-gdoc
description: Playground for GDrive using go as Obsidian plugin

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p build && go run ./go/cmd/gents && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o build/plugin.wasm ./go/cmd/plugin && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" build/wasm_exec.js
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
